items.description: Cerebras Systems raised $5.5 billion in one of the largest semiconductor IPOs, with shares closing at $311 on May 14, 2026. actions: 封测及先进封装厂商应密切关注晶圆级芯片的封装与互联需求，探索针对超大尺寸芯片的新型封装合作机会。
